step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts JD Power's AI Cloud data lake solution. Users interact via a Web Console (UserConsumerWeb) authenticated by Amazon Cognito. Data ingestion connections stream into S3 from various sources (RDS, S3, FTP, API). Ingestion triggers AWS Lambda, which invokes AWS Glue for out-of-the-box crawling or AWS Fargate for custom crawling. Catalogs are stored in Glue. Athena executes query transformations on S3, while data is loaded into Amazon Redshift for analytical platform reporting. Fargate also hosts Jupyter and RStudio environments for Machine Learning workloads.
